assumptions.choice: Feed timestamps are interpreted as US/Eastern for session-time comparisons.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines all session times in US/Eastern and the supplied bars are timestamped -04:00.

assumptions.choice: A down-cross is prior RSI at or above the threshold and current RSI below it; an up-cross is prior RSI at or below the threshold and current RSI above it.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal strict reading of crossing below or above a level.

assumptions.choice: Protective Backtrader stop orders are submitted after the entry order completes, using its actual execution price and the full open position size.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits Backtrader stop orders and defines the stop distance from entry price.

assumptions.choice: The 14:30 time exit submits a market close order on the 14:30 bar.
assumptions.reason: Without harness-controlled cheat-on-close, Backtrader market orders normally execute on the following bar, so an exact same-bar 14:30 fill cannot be guaranteed.
